test_title: PYST 50 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 30 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the following sentences to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph:

P. The last sculpture, a woman carved from one block of marble, had an expression of deep sorrow.

Q. For months, the sculptor had worked incessantly, hacking away at the rock.

R. She was motivated by a black-and-white photo of her grandmother taken during times of severe hardship.

S. The painting was a dedication, a gesture of honouring the memory and the resilience of the woman.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. R, Q, P, S .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The paragraph must have logical flow and coherence.
 
• Option 2 (R, Q, P, S) forms a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph.
 
• Explanation of the arrangement:
 
 
• R introduces the motivation behind the sculpture by describing the photo of the grandmother.
 
• Q follows logically, describing how the sculptor worked for months inspired by the grandmother's photo.
 
• P then describes the result of the effort—the sculpture with an expression of sorrow.
 
• S concludes the paragraph, tying it back to the purpose of the sculpture—to honor the grandmother’s resilience.
 
 

Correct arrangement: *R, Q, P, S*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Guidelines for Rearranging Sentences:**
 
 
• Identify the introductory sentence (usually gives context or introduces the main idea).
 
• Look for logical connectors or chronological clues for sequencing.
 
• Ensure the paragraph ends with a conclusion or summary tying back to the main idea.
 
 

47:T
